messages.author: 263ab4e55fc920c4
messages.subject: Bayesian equivalent of a variance component
parts:
How can I calculate a Bayesian equivalent of a variance component for a random variable in an INLA “iid” random effect model from the estimated precision for the random effect.

 

Thanks

Christian Damgaard

Yes, there seems to have been some confusion about what you were really asking...

I find lots of google hits on "Bayesian variance components", such as this,
  http://www.pstat.ucsb.edu/faculty/John_Hsu/papers/JASA96.pdf

I have never worked on variance component models however, so I'm not sure how to translate that into INLA-compatible language.

y = X %*% beta + Z %*% z + eps
